[n0v0id](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/n0v0id)


September 29, 2026, 4:03pm 1


[Screenshot_20260929-175306 1080×2400 253 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/c/c2be66ab7c6e76e1d3e1c250d1a266c3d5b8f275.png)


This is how the new UI looks on my side. My issue refers to the bottom button bar (Sorry, I don’t know its designated name) that starts with the + symbol and the All, Unread, Focus, Saved and Preferences.


Inside a feed, this bar migrates to “All Newest”, “Search” and mark all articles as read:


[Screenshot_20260929-175701 1080×2400 272 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/a/ae2e97cdab7b2074d09aedc70e70f6ab625017e9.png)


In both views, I do find it hard to select entries from the bottom of a list. Some edge cases are almost impossible to select. I need to move the entries down in order to get them between the absolute bottom below that button bars and try to click on them in the tiny space left without accidentally invoking any NewsBlur button of that button bar or the system bar below.


I’d say this is not an option for smaller screens or older people.


I tried to locate some settings to make this hover bar a normal button bar that does not cover the content of the lists. Maybe I don’t know exactly what to look for.


However, I really would like to change that behavior as it constantly gets in my way the way it is now.


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


September 30, 2026, 3:24am 2


For the story list, go to Preferences > Story Layout > Story list toolbar position and choose Top. That puts the controls above the stories so they don’t cover the content.


The main feed list doesn’t have that option, nor does it need it. You should still be able to scroll the last entries above the floating bar. Does the last entry stay covered even when you scroll all the way to the bottom?


[n0v0id](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/n0v0id)


September 30, 2026, 7:17am 3


Thanks. This solves the issue for the story list.


For the main feed list: the issue still persists from my point of view: the last entry is visible in the gap between the toolbar and the very bottom of the screen, yes. I don’t like the fact that the two items above are covered. In order to read or select them, I need to scroll a bit so that they are visible in this tiny gap to interact with. Since “Saved stories” is an element I’m using very frequently, this is a frustrating situation for me.


I wish there was a top position for that main feed list floating bar as well.


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


September 30, 2026, 3:48pm 4


Please post a screenshot! It looks fine to me and this is basically the same behavior as before, it’s just that the bottom bar is now hovering over the content instead of having an opaque container.


[n0v0id](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/n0v0id)


September 30, 2026, 9:15pm 5


[2026-09-30T23.07.09 -- screenshots 1080×2400 271 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/5/5225fb11dd0b5067af9c0b2c803cfc54fa9ef3e3.png)


In this screenshot you see that the element below the bar isn’t visible at all, marked by that question mark. So the user needs to scroll around in order to see if there is something important hidden by the bar.


Furthermore, the screen estate which allows for seleting the “Saved Stories” (I use frequently throughout the day!) is very limited to the two small purple areas.


[2026-09-30T23.07.21 -- screenshots 1080×2400 266 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/8/87b4005afd3392f90edd5163563167114a94bd1a.png)


In order to see what’s blocked by the bar, I now have scrolled a bit. And also this element can only be accessed via the two small purple marked areas.


I really don’t see any positive aspect of this design decision to be honest. It divides the content into easy accessible content (above the bar), hidden content (below the bar) and hard to interact content (below the bar).


If there would be a similar option as with the other list view, I could switch to a view where content is never hidden.


[n0v0id](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/n0v0id)


October 3, 2026, 5:20pm 6


I had an idea for a workaround: since the folders are sorted in alphabetic order, I created dummy folders whose name started with “Z”. Unfortunately, this doesn’t work because the two special folders “Saved Stories” and “Read Stories” are not sorted alphabetically, they’re always the last (partially hidden) folders.


So no luck there as well.


[n0v0id](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/n0v0id)


October 17, 2026, 10:40am 7


[2026-10-15T14.28.09 NewsBlur - fixed UI with whitespace at bottom Tesla Radar - -- screenshots 1080×2400 238 KB](https://forum.newsblur.com/uploads/default/original/2X/0/06787daede00be2705ce81b4943e089a10206f2d.png)


It’s fixed now. Thank you.


Solution implemented: whitespace at the bottom so that the content is able to be scrolled above the UI items that would block it otherwise.
